infobox.usage: Unlocks the gas station office door on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gas station office key (Gas Office) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the director's office room inside one of the gas stations.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - It's much easier to see through the window from inside than it is from outside

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The last room on the right in the hallway inside the gas station on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Safe
- 1x Pistols spawn on the desk
- Gas station storage room key spawn, under the table
- Loose loot (Currency, )
- Possible Weapon box (4x4) in the corner
